description: This source file implements DNS reloader functionality for systems with res_ninit support, including a class DnsReloader that observes DNS changes and reloads resolver state accordingly. It manages DNS configuration updates on POSIX systems, excluding macOS, iOS, Android, and Fuchsia.

classes.name: DnsReloader
classes.description: A class that observes DNS changes via NetworkChangeNotifier and reloads DNS resolver state using res_ninit and res_nclose functions, with thread-local storage for managing reload state.

methods.name: EnsureDnsReloaderInit
methods.description: Initializes the DNS reloader singleton instance.

methods.name: DnsReloaderMaybeReload
methods.description: Triggers a reload of DNS resolver state if needed, called from DNS worker threads.
